about.heading: Artistry Rooted in Elegance & Individuality
about.leadText: Amrapali is a professional makeup artist based in Bhiwandi, Maharashtra. She offers personalised makeup services for bridal and other special occasions.
about.bioParagraph1: With 1–3 years of professional experience, Amrapali focuses on enhancing each client’s unique features rather than applying one-size-fits-all looks. Every makeover is tailored to your occasion, personal style, and wedding theme.
about.bioParagraph2: Operating exclusively on-location, she travels to client venues across Maharashtra (subject to date and availability), ensuring a calm, punctual, and attentive beauty experience on your most meaningful day.
about.approachDescription: Every face and occasion is unique. Bespoke consultations ensure your bridal, haldi, engagement, or party look feels authentically yours.

faqSection.heading: Common Enquiries & Booking Details
faqSection.subheadline: Clear, honest answers to essential questions regarding our on-location services, travel availability, and enquiry process.

items.question: What makeup services does Amrapali Makeover offer?
items.answer: Amrapali Makeover specializes exclusively in four bespoke on-location makeup services: Bridal Makeup, Haldi Makeup, Engagement Makeup, and Party Makeup. Every look is tailored to your personal style, skin tone, and outfit aesthetic.

items.question: Does Amrapali provide on-location makeup services?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely. All makeup services are delivered entirely on-location at your chosen wedding venue, banquet hall, hotel, or residence. Amrapali does not operate a commercial salon or storefront.

items.question: Where is Amrapali Makeover based?
items.answer: Amrapali Makeover is based in Bhiwandi, Thane District, Maharashtra, India. Services are provided across Bhiwandi and surrounding regions.

items.question: Does the artist travel outside Bhiwandi?
items.answer: Yes. Travel enquiries across Maharashtra are considered depending on the event date, venue location, travel logistics, and existing schedule availability. Travel bookings are evaluated on an individual enquiry basis.

items.question: Do customers visit the artist's home or studio?
items.answer: No. Amrapali operates strictly on-location at client venues. To preserve client comfort and artist privacy, clients do not visit the artist's private residence.

items.question: How can customers enquire about pricing?
items.answer: All pricing is customized and enquiry-based depending on your occasion, event date, venue location, and requirements. You can enquire directly via WhatsApp at +91 83089 44456 for a personalized quotation.

items.question: How does the booking process work?
items.answer: The booking process involves four simple steps: 1) Send an initial enquiry with your occasion, date, venue location, and preferred ready-by time; 2) Date and location check by Amrapali; 3) Personal style consultation to discuss your vision; 4) Mutual confirmation once schedule feasibility and details are mutually agreed.

items.question: Is a WhatsApp enquiry a confirmed booking?
items.answer: No. An initial WhatsApp message does not guarantee or confirm a booking. An appointment is only confirmed once schedule feasibility is verified and all details are mutually finalized directly with Amrapali.
